identities.freeAddressHint: Any address you are allowed to send from. The server has the final say — if it refuses this address, sending will fail.

help.title: Rule editor — help
help.headerDesc: Match against the corresponding email header.
help.sizeDesc: Message size in bytes — use is larger than / is smaller than.
help.bodyDesc: Search inside the message body text.
help.envelopeDesc: Match the real SMTP sender/recipient, ignoring display headers.
help.detailDesc: Match the +tag part of an address like you+shopping@….
help.duplicateDesc: Fires when a similar message was already received within the given time window (seconds).
help.dateDesc: Compare the current date or the date in the message header against a fixed date.
help.whenDesc: Filter by the day of the week or the hour of the day when the message arrives.
help.containsDesc: The field includes the text anywhere (case-insensitive).
help.equalsDesc: Exact match of the entire field value.
help.wildcardDesc: Glob pattern — * matches any sequence of characters, ? matches exactly one.
help.sizeCompareDesc: Numeric comparison, for the Size field only.
help.dateCompareDesc: Date comparison, for date and time fields only.
help.fileIntoDesc: Move the message into the specified folder. Enable Create to auto-create the folder if it doesn't exist Extended.
help.redirectDesc: Forward a copy of the message to another address.
help.rejectDesc: Refuse the message at delivery with an optional error text sent back to the sender.
help.discardDesc: Silently drop the message — no bounce, no copy kept.
help.keepDesc: Explicitly keep a copy in the inbox, useful when combined with another action.
help.markReadDesc: Automatically mark the message as read upon delivery.
help.markFlaggedDesc: Add the starred/flagged flag to the message.
help.stopAfterDesc: If this rule matches, no further rules in the list are evaluated. Without this, all matching rules apply in order.
